high_level_description: This image is an artist's depiction of the Voyager 1 spacecraft, which is described as "The first spacecraft to leave the solar system." The image is set against a cosmic background filled with stars and nebulae, giving it a sense of vastness and exploration. Voyager 1 Spacecraft: The spacecraft is shown in silhouette, emphasizing its shape and structure. It features a large, dish-like antenna at the top, which is characteristic of its design for communication purposes. Various scientific instruments and components are attached to the main body, indicating its role in space
